source.text: Unfortunately, I had a really disappointing experience yesterday. I found a large piece of plastic in my food. What makes it even more upsetting is that this is my favorite restaurant and the place I always recommend to anyone looking for an authentic South Indian dining experience. Please check your food if you would still prefer to go there.

the place is an authentic South Indian dining experience

reference.notes: The plastic is a foreign object in the food, so food_hygiene fits it. 'Always recommend' and 'favorite restaurant' are positive verdicts about the past. The closing warning reads as a cautionary verdict.
